landing.title: Every review, answered. Every customer, back.
landing.subtitle: Atterna reads your Google reviews, drafts replies in your voice in Greek and English, and turns private feedback into a calmer way to grow.
landing.trust: Designed with taverna owners, dentists and garages across Greece.
landing.microTrust: No card · 14-day free trial · EU-hosted data
landing.problemEyebrow: The quiet cost of being missed
landing.problemBody: Between the dinner rush and the last appointment, good feedback gets buried and difficult feedback arrives too late. Atterna keeps the signal clear, so you can act while it still matters.

problemStats.return: more return visits with a reply within 24h

feature1.title: Every review, in one quiet place.
feature1.body: Google reviews arrive with the context you need: sentiment, language, topics, and urgency. No sprawling dashboard. Just the next useful thing.
feature1.points: Syncs Google Business Profile|Unanswered reviews rise to the top|Greek and English side by side

feature2.title: Replies that sound like you.
feature2.body: Choose a tone, review the draft, and publish when it feels right. Atterna helps you be prompt without becoming generic.
feature2.points: Friendly, formal, or apologetic tones|Bilingual drafts with local nuance|You approve every public reply

feature3.title: Catch the problem while it is still private.
feature3.body: A simple QR card invites honest feedback. Happy guests can share publicly; unhappy guests reach you first.
feature3.points: Tokenized QR links for the counter|4–5 stars can continue to Google|Low ratings alert the owner

feature4.title: The whole picture, once a week.
feature4.body: A concise report turns a week of scattered comments into a clear view of what guests loved and what needs attention.
feature4.points: Rating trend and new reviews|Top compliments and complaints|One suggested action

faq.oneQ: Is it safe to connect Google?
faq.oneA: Atterna uses the official Google connection and only requests the access needed to read reviews and publish replies you approve.
faq.twoQ: Does it really work in Greek?
faq.twoA: Yes. Greek is the primary language of the product, analysis, and reply drafts. English is available alongside it.
faq.threeA: Your data is handled through the services configured for your account and can be hosted in the EU. Ask us for the current data-processing details.
faq.fourA: Yes. Cancel anytime from the subscription area; there is no lock-in.
faq.fiveA: The trial gives you the core review inbox, analysis, private feedback flow, and reply workflow so you can judge the fit in a real week.
faq.sixA: You do. Atterna drafts and sends only after you approve the public reply.
